name: outboxlab
description: OutboxLab - distributed outbound email scheduler with per-sender rate limiting, restart-safe persistence and a realtime glassmorphic dashboard
author: Sayandip Jana

scripts.setup: npm run env:init && npm run infra:up && npm run install:all && npm run db:setup
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.infra:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix backend run db:generate && npm --prefix backend run db:migrate && npm --prefix backend run db:seed
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm --prefix backend run start:api" "npm --prefix backend run start:worker" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
